title.narrative: Support of vulnerable families for winterization in Zaporizka, Chernigivska and Mykolaivska oblasts.

description.narrative: ltpgtProject aimed at providing support of vulnerable families – 4000 HHs, 12000 individuals for winterization in Zaporizka, Chernigivska and Mykolaivska oblasts through the following:ltbrgt1) Cash for winter energy (firewood) for 3000 HHs, 9000 individuals (2500 HHs, 7500 individuals in Zaporizka oblast and 500 HHs, 1500 individuals in Chernigivska oblast)ltbrgt2) Cash for utilities (central gas) for 500 HHs, 1500 individuals in Mykolaivska oblast.ltbrgt3) Cash for utilities (central heating) for 500 HHs, 1500 individuals in Zaporizka oblast. ltbrgt ltbrgtThis assistance will be provided in the form of cash from our bank account to the bank account of beneficiaries. The amount for each type of cash assistance was defined according to the Shelter Cluster recommendations. Cash for winter energy will be provided for purchasing firewood. The cash for utilities - grant will cover heating utility costs that families will face in winter months, vulnerable categories. The coverage corresponds with Shelter Cluster recommendation in terms of 6 months period (from October to April).ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtTarget groups (beneficiaries) (according to the Winterization recommendations from Shelter Cluster): displaced families, non-displaced families affected by war or living in substandard houses, returnee families, which winterization needs unmet because: lt/pgtltpgt 1) they do not have the capacity 2) not receiving winterization-related state support (state subsidies or other winterization programs see Chapter about Engagement with government in this document), ltbrgt who belong to one of the prioritized target groups: 1) non-displaced families in war-damaged areas 2) non-displaced and returnee families in damaged houses 3) displaced, non-displaced, and returnee families in substandard houses 4) displaced, hosting, non-displaced, and returnee families not able to pay utility bills, ltbrgt which, at the same time belong to one or more of the vulnerability groups: 1) persons with disabilities 2) older persons (60+) 3) single-headed households and/or women who are the main caregivers for the family 4) families with three or more children (under 18 or 23 years if they are studying) 5) pregnant women and families with children under three years old 6) persons with chronic illness and serious medical conditions (including mental health issues). ltbrgt Women are the majority among adults in such families. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt ltbrgt10% of beneficiaries (women and men, girls and boys) will be the persons with disabilities.lt/pgtltpgtUFF within the project has call-center for providing the consultations, receiving the feedback and online form for feedback. We’ll conduct the permanent monitoring within the project. We’ll share to beneficiaries informational flyer with info on contacts to inform about SEA cases.ltbrgtLocalization: We have one local partner organization in Chernigivska oblast – NGO «Center for Social Welfare «Dobrochyn» (Dobrochyn) which successfully implemented as a sub-partner our project supported by UHF with MPC component. We will provide two trainings and security items for strengthening their capacities.ltbrgtWe will train all our staff and staff of the partner organizations on GBV, our PSEA policy for usage of this information in their work.ltbrgtlt/pgt
